newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end sharply up on spec, fund buying.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end sharply up on spec, fund buying.

text.p: NYCE Frozen concentrated orange juice finished sharply firmer on speculative and fund buying as prices corrected from an oversold condition, market sources said.
November closed at 112.90, up 4.80, having ranged from 113.10 to 108.45. The back months finished up 3.40 to 2.90.
Volume was estimated at a brisk 6,500 lots.
Floor sources said prices have probably hit the bottom of the trading range and today's move signals the beginning of an uptrend.
"All the funds are getting in," one floor source said.
But Paine Webber analyst Bernard Savaiko said "aside from a technical bounce, it is premature to be talking about a major move up."
Expectations are for increased production and inventories in 1996/97 from year-ago levels, he noted. The U.S. Department of Agriculture will release its estimate of the Florida crop October 11.
